author: hattrill
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
* CYTOCHROME C OXIDASE ASSEMBLY PROTEIN COX15 (PTHR23289)
* PTN000590786


* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
* 'oxidoreductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H, heme protein as acceptor' GO:0016653 is incorrect for cox15 is the heme A synthase
New term created for this activty is:
[GO:0120547 heme A synthase activity ](https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29711)

@srengel https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P40086/entry COX15 SGD:S000000943 should be re-annotated with GO:0120547 heme A synthase activity

@ValWood this maps to etp1, which is a  'fusion' of heme A syn and ferredoxin.  https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q10361/entry  - so I think that it would have both 'heme A synthase activity' and 'electron transfer activity', respectively.
